faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Cappadocia transfer and taxi service.

vipFaq.q1: What's the difference between VIP transfer and regular transfer?
vipFaq.a1: VIP transfer includes luxury vehicles like Mercedes Vito, personal meet & greet, flight tracking, and door-to-door service. Our vehicles are air-conditioned, spacious, and comfortable.
vipFaq.q2: How will I be met at the airport?
vipFaq.a2: Our driver will wait at the arrivals terminal with a sign showing your name. We track your flight even if it's delayed.
vipFaq.q3: What size vehicles do you have?
vipFaq.a3: We use sedans for 1-3 passengers and Mercedes Vito minibus for 4-8 passengers. For larger groups, we can arrange minibuses.
vipFaq.q4: Is luggage included in the price?
vipFaq.a4: Yes, standard luggage is included. Just let us know in advance if you have extra large bags or special equipment.
vipFaq.a5: You can pay by cash (TRY, EUR, USD) or credit card. Payment is collected at the end of the journey in the vehicle.
vipFaq.q6: How can I cancel my reservation?
vipFaq.a6: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. Just contact us via WhatsApp or phone.
vipFaq.a7: Yes, we provide free child seats. Just mention it when booking.
vipFaq.q8: Do you have transfers for night flights?
vipFaq.a8: Yes, we operate 24/7. Our driver will be ready even for flights arriving at 3:00 AM.
